data.title: Venezuelan Man Arrested Near White House After Claiming He Planned to Assassinate U.S. President Donald Trump
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Fox News, U.S. Department of Homeland Security officials said a Venezuelan national was arrested by Secret Service agents near the White House on Thursday night. Agents approached his vehicle on Constitution Avenue in Washington after noticing suspicious behavior. The man said voices in his head told him to travel to Washington to assassinate the president and admitted there were weapons in the vehicle.

The vehicle had previously been reported stolen. A search found three firearms and dozens of rounds of ammunition, including an AR-15-style rifle and two handguns. The suspect, Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos, entered the United States through Texas in March 2024 and was previously arrested by Border Patrol before being released into the country during the Biden administration.

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement requested that the U.S. Marshals Service, which is holding the suspect, detain him. Prosecutors filed charges including carrying a rifle outside a home or business, illegally transporting firearms, possessing unregistered firearms and ammunition, unauthorized use of a motor vehicle, theft, and receiving stolen property. Secret Service Director Sean Curran said personnel used their training to address an imminent threat to their protectee and the public.

data.title: PS5 Pro Sold Out Everywhere as GTA VI Pre-Loads Start Next Week
data.description: GTA VI pre-downloads begin Tuesday, November 10, and require 212 GB of free storage, while the PS5 Pro is sold out at major U.S. retailers. Retailers list the console at its $899 price, while resellers ask $1,399 to more than $1,600, according to BeInCrypto. Sony raised PS5 Pro prices by $200 since April and lifted its net profit forecast for the year ending March 2027 to a record 1.33 trillion yen; its shares rallied 7% this week before giving back part of their gains Friday. GTA VI launches Nov. 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Take-Two Interactive’s stock slide this year leaves it heavily dependent on the release.

data.title: Fomo Names Clicker Creator Kyle Head of Partnerships

According to Foresight News, he will focus on public-chain partnerships and team tags, with the aim of increasing activity and helping project teams reach token holders directly. Kyle previously made an angel investment in Fomo, and his public account ranks among the top 20 on the platform’s all-time trading leaderboard.

data.title: Aave Founder Stani Kulechov: Bitcoin Is More Important Than Ever Amid Paraguay Bank Crisis
data.description: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Bitcoin is more important than ever, pointing to events in Paraguay. According to Foresight News, his remarks came as depositors at Paraguayan digital bank Ueno were unable to withdraw funds after the central bank took control of the bank. Reuters reported that the situation prompted protests calling for the return of funds, faster compensation and accountability. Those affected included retirees who received pension payments through Ueno.

data.title: JUST, Monero and LEO Token Defy Crypto Market Crash
data.description: JUST (JST), Monero (XMR) and LEO Token (LEO) have held key technical levels as Bitcoin trades around $76,000 amid a broader market downturn. The three altcoins have shown resilience, according to BeInCrypto: JST has gained roughly 265% since February, XMR is up more than 120% from its February low near $276, and LEO trades roughly 12% below its May all-time high of $10.61. data.title: More Than Six Blockworks Research Team Members Announce Departures
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, more than six members of Blockworks’ research team announced their departures on social media on November 6. Those named included senior research analyst Jake Koch-Gallup, research analysts Nick Carpineto and Kunal Doshi, senior protocol strategist Silvio Busonero, and founding research team member Westie Revacc. The posts did not specify reasons for the departures. Koch-Gallup linked them to a strategic shift at Blockworks, saying the company was moving its focus away from research and toward other areas.

On November 3, Blockworks announced that its MCP product was open to all users, allowing them to connect Blockworks to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or other MCP clients to build agents. In June, Blockworks announced its acquisition of crypto research platform Messari.

data.title: Blockstream Says Bitcoin Can Prepare for Quantum Threats With New Signature Technology
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Bloomingbit, Blockstream said in its third-quarter business update that Bitcoin could prepare for future quantum-computer attacks by adopting new digital signature technology. The company’s team compared three lattice-based schemes: Dilithium, Falcon, and Hawk.

Researchers said Falcon-1024 offers the best balance of data size, verification speed, and maturity of its security foundations. They said it would be their choice if Bitcoin needed a lattice-based signature scheme today. Key challenges include finalizing the Falcon standard, developing verified implementations, and managing the memory demands on hardware wallets. The team described hash-based signatures as a more conservative near-term option and said the two approaches could be combined once Falcon’s standards and implementation technology mature, potentially improving security and processing efficiency.

data.title: NYT Reports Suspicious Prediction Market Bets Before Poll Releases
data.description:
Suspicious prediction market bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls became public, according to a report. According to Cointelegraph, Vanderbilt University researchers said a Polymarket user wagered almost $200,000 on Oct. 31 that Nebraska Senator Pete Ricketts would be re-elected, and a Times/Siena poll released an hour later showed Ricketts in the lead. A Friday report by The New York Times said it was unclear whether the user had access to inside information, but the bettor won more than $77,000. The user also placed similar large bets on other markets, including Kalshi. Brett Goldstein of the Vanderbilt Institute of National Security said the circumstances were difficult to dismiss as random and required further investigation. Polymarket said it had identified the trades and was investigating, while Kalshi declined to comment.

Cointelegraph reported in April that a US Army soldier had been charged after allegedly earning more than $400,000 by betting on a prediction market using nonpublic information connected to a US operation involving then Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro. The Department of Justice alleged that Master Sergeant Gannon Ken Van Dyke participated in planning and carrying out Operation Absolute Resolve, which led to Maduro’s capture at a residence in Caracas, Venezuela, in January. According to the DOJ, Van Dyke allegedly used that information to purchase “yes” shares in Polymarket contracts tied to the operation, including “Maduro out by January 31” and “Trump invokes War Powers against Venezuela by January 31.” The cases involve separate prediction market activity, and the report did not establish whether the bets made ahead of the Times/Siena poll releases relied on inside information. Polymarket said its investigation into the trades was ongoing.

data.title: ARK Plans 14 Thematic ETFs Covering AI and Tokenized Markets
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, ARK ETF Trust filed registration documents with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for 14 thematic ETFs covering areas including artificial intelligence, robotics, biotechnology and tokenized-market infrastructure. The preliminary prospectus is dated November 6 and is expected to become effective 75 days after filing.

One proposed fund, the ARK Tokenized Market Infrastructure ETF, would invest in companies providing infrastructure for real-world asset tokenization and on-chain capital markets, including tokenization platforms, stablecoin issuers, exchanges, brokers, custodians and settlement networks. The other proposed funds are ARK Neobanks ETF, ARK Agentic Cyber Defense ETF, ARK Neoclouds ETF, ARK Frontier AI Labs ETF, ARK AI Agents ETF, ARK Orbital Data Centers ETF, ARK Robotaxis ETF, ARK Humanoid Robots & Physical AI ETF, ARK Brain Computer Interfaces & Surgical Robotics ETF, ARK Longevity ETF, ARK Peptides ETF, ARK AI Factory ETF and ARK Functional Cures ETF. Tickers have not been determined, and the SEC has neither approved nor rejected the securities.
